properties.name: Bölcske utca
properties.approximationNote: Rough lower Bölcske-street residential/cellar quarter using mapped Belső/Felső/Alsó Bölcske and Kiskúti/Zrínyi connections, not merely a buffer on one road. Outer hill-block limits are inferred.

properties.name: Kecskehegy
properties.approximationNote: Rough Hősök tere/Kecskeugrató hill-quarter extent, reconstructed from actual roads and the riverbank slope; distinct from a radius around the name point.

properties.name: Kálváriahegy
properties.approximationNote: Rough Kálvária hill-and-slope quarter, based on native mapped Kálvária/Alsó Kálvária and Burgundia street fabric. Includes more than the chapel/monument footprint; slope connectors inferred.

supportingFacts.fact: Indexed municipal ITS text places Tabán and Kálvária in the central action area and refers to Sóház/Ady Endre streets. The binary endpoint returned403 to the web connector, so exact map boundaries are not claimed.

properties.name: Tabán
properties.approximationNote: Rough historical Tabán built quarter east of the railway/Ady Endre corridor below Kálvária, using actual Tabán/Öregárok/Alsóburgundia roads. Ridge-side boundary connections estimated.

supportingFacts.fact: Indexed municipal ITS text places Tabán and Kálvária in the central action area and refers to Sóház/Ady Endre streets. The binary endpoint returned403 to the web connector, so exact map boundaries are not claimed.

properties.name: Templomhegy
properties.approximationNote: Rough whole local hill/street quarter northwest of the castle using the native Petőfi/Templom/Ilona street fabric and church-plot context. Outer slopes/road connections are inferred, not a building footprint.

properties.name: Váralja
properties.approximationNote: Rough lower-castle street quarter around Rátkay/Rákóczi/Jókai approaches and the bridge-side foot of the hill. Native street context with estimated closure, may overlap the hillside quarter.

properties.name: Várdomb
properties.approximationNote: Rough castle hill area including the hilltop and surrounding approach/green space, reconstructed from the native local road map. Extent is larger than a castle building polygon; slope/foot connections estimated.

properties.name: Alsóbélatelep
properties.approximationNote: Rough western coastal residential-grid extent from the native street/rail map, clipped to the frozen built-area surface. West/upper separation from Bélatelep is approximate; overlapping searches are intentional. Whole built neighbourhood estimate, not a radius.

supportingFacts.fact: The municipal healthcare ordinance places the two named western neighbourhoods on the western side of the Balaton/Sándor/Szent István street boundary. This is supporting location evidence, not an individual quarter boundary.

properties.name: Bélatelep
properties.approximationNote: Rough historic western hillside/coastal neighbourhood extent following the actual coastal transport corridor and hill street fabric. The southern/eastern ridge connections are inferred; not a surveyed or formal quarter boundary.

supportingFacts.fact: The municipal healthcare ordinance places the two named western neighbourhoods on the western side of the Balaton/Sándor/Szent István street boundary. This is supporting location evidence, not an individual quarter boundary.

properties.name: Fonyódliget
properties.approximationNote: Rough eastern lakeside holiday/residential strip along Köztársaság/coastal railway, including the named southern street grid; clipped to built context to avoid treating the large fishing ponds as the neighbourhood. Canal/rail-end links estimated.

properties.name: Fürdőtelep
properties.approximationNote: Rough central holiday neighbourhood around the Ady Endre/coastal rail corridor, using mapped residential streets and the eastern rail/water edge. Internal divisions are map estimates.

properties.name: Kertváros
properties.approximationNote: Approximate garden suburb south/east of the western coastal rail corridor, based on actual local street-grid and built-area edge. Street-block-scale outer connections estimated from map context.

supportingFacts.fact: The municipal healthcare ordinance places the two named western neighbourhoods on the western side of the Balaton/Sándor/Szent István street boundary. This is supporting location evidence, not an individual quarter boundary.

properties.name: Sándortelep
properties.approximationNote: Approximate north-south built strip around Szent István/Sándor street fabric; Bézsenyi street and water/rail edges guide the outer extent. May overlap the broader holiday-quarter interpretation; not an official subdivision.

properties.name: Csajdakert
properties.approximationNote: Approximate park/bath complex extent including the native water-park grounds and adjoining green area. Municipal street-bounded park description supports identity; not just a pool/building footprint. South/west parcel connections are estimated.

supportingFacts.fact: Municipal heritage rule identifies the Csajdakert park/bath complex by Kossuth, Csajda, Zöldfa and Hősök streets. The source cites parcels1479/13 and1479/14.

properties.name: Homokgyőr
properties.approximationNote: Rough whole rural locality including its farmyard/residential core and adjacent local access-road/field blocks northeast of Gombolyagi street and above the railway. Boundary connections across fields are estimates, not a standalone small farm-building footprint.

supportingFacts.fact: The source locates Homokgyőr north-east of Gombolyagi út and references the railway as a boundary. Other closure segments remain estimates.

properties.name: Széchenyi-lakótelep
properties.approximationNote: Rough full estate block reconstructed from Széchenyi/Kossuth, Csajda and Kubinszky local road context and the panel-building/service-road fabric. Not a small building footprint; outside block connections are inferred.

properties.name: Urbántanya
properties.approximationNote: Rough rural locality extent around its native farmyard/access roads on the eastern channel bank, including surrounding homestead land. Boundary links between road/field corners are inferred; not a small building polygon.

properties.name: Vörösszállás
properties.approximationNote: Rough isolated rural settlement extent encompassing the mapped built core and its approach/field block, using the named Vörösszállás access road. Field-edge closure is inferred; not a circle or a building footprint.

properties.name: Zrínyi-lakótelep
properties.approximationNote: Approximate estate extent guided by municipal Pataji/Kossuth/Gombolyagi/Zrínyi street description and actual street geometry. Retains all estate-scale blocks rather than one building; precise outer corner/closure connections estimated.

supportingFacts.fact: Municipal planning study describes the estate using Pataji, Kossuth Lajos, Gombolyagi and Zrínyi streets. Reconstruct coarsely from actual street geometry rather than a point radius.

properties.name: Árendás-dűlő
properties.approximationNote: Rough agricultural/garden locality west of Meszesi/Bátyai, using the actual Árendás/Duna approach-road fabric, northern canal and field-block edges. No official dűlő survey claimed; deliberately broader than the house/street footprint and no radius construction.

properties.name: Érsekkert
properties.approximationNote: Approximate whole historical park extent, traced from native service/park paths, Vajas-channel bank and the surrounding Érsekkert/Asztrik street context. No invented residential footprint or palace-only polygon; local parcel edges are estimated.

supportingFacts.fact: Municipal tourism description identifies Érsekkert as the historical park at Érsekkert út1; park name and mapped landuse are appropriate identity evidence.
